text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Is this power... welling up inside 
me...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Could this be... words of encouragement 
from the Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, I have received it loud and 
clear. The wishes of all our predecessors, 
with my whole body and soul.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I will surely become the next stepping 
stone, and pass the baton forward to 
future generations of Umamusume!
